title: The Inscription
subtitle: hideTextUntilComplete
description: `hideTextUntilComplete` withholds the description until the quest is completed — for a quest whose text would give away what it asks for. The node, its name and its tasks are all still there; only the prose is held back.
The editor always shows text a reader would not yet see, which is the point: the author writes the reveal, and the reader meets it.
